summary: Frontend-only regression testing after warm gold/brown/cream re-theme + hero poster fix on Ashin Jinarakkhita booking site. All 5 requested checks PASSED. Hero poster image loads successfully (naturalWidth=1279, naturalHeight=1600) with correct webp URL. Booking flow Step1->Step2->Step3 works end-to-end (name/phone fill -> Lanjut -> session-1 open with '92 kursi tersisa' (data-testid=session-remaining-1) and sessions 2/3/4 locked/disabled -> selecting session-1 + Lanjut renders SeatMap with LAYAR label). data-testid=link-upload-strip present and href='/upload' navigates correctly. Admin login (admin1/admin123) succeeds and Panel Admin dashboard renders with new warm maroon/amber theme; stats (Perlu Verifikasi, Terverifikasi, Tiket Terjual, Pendapatan Rp 1.550.000) and Daftar Pesanan table visible. Note: automated 'Orders/Dashboard' text check returned False only because dashboard is in Bahasa Indonesia ('Panel Admin' / 'Daftar Pesanan'); screenshot confirms full functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: BookingPage.js is 421 lines - approaching maintainability threshold; consider splitting SessionCard and step components into separate files.
session-remaining-1 text renders concatenated ('92kursi tersisa8/100 kursi terisi') due to sibling spans without whitespace - visually fine due to layout but not ideal for screen readers.
POSTER_URL is hardcoded to an emergentagent.net CDN URL; if the artifact expires, the hero image will break. Consider self-hosting under /public or documenting the dependency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-theme (maroon #7A241F + amber #B26A1E, Playfair Display/DM Sans) applied cleanly. Preview MongoDB has active data (23 online + 8 walk-in verified tickets, Sesi 1 has 8/100 booked). Do NOT complete payment flows to avoid polluting data.
